# UMNI-CRL attribution
`methods/umni.py` adapts the hard-intervention algorithm and helper routines from
https://github.com/acarturk-e/score-based-crl (UMNI-CRL).
See UMNI-CRL-LICENSE.txt for the unchanged Apache-2.0 license.
The adapted implementation uses sample-covariance score differences and a
vectorized weight search. This notice attributes third-party work.
